6b0bcd3673f9b6adba54.text: This module was designed and written to help you master the skills in using transition

6a0913456b66fdc2eacc.text: signals to indicate coherence in writing sentences and paragraphs. The activities are arranged to follow the standard sequence of the lesson, but the order in which you read them can be changed to correspond with the Learner’s Material (LM) you are now using.

2fdd69ff87662a8e33f0.text: Here, you are expected to develop your knowledge and skill in identifying and using

5fc55155f5751dd8ebcd.text: cohesive devices or transition signals to indicate coherence.

b4ccbf4f9fcaf6ec0146.text: The Most Essential Learning Competency (MELC) covered in this module is identify

f99763ba74c398f13d68.text: and use signals that indicate coherence (e.g. additive - also, moreover; causative – as a result, consequently; conditional/concessional – otherwise, in that case, however; sequential – to begin with, in conclusion; clarifying – for instance, in fact, in addition);

a5170a86956fb05123aa.text: As learners of this module, you are expected to: •

576dc176acb3e7ec1c8d.text: identify transition signals used in sentences and paragraphs; • classify the types of transition signals used in sentences and paragraphs; • scan texts rapidly for connecting words or expressions that signal sequence; • construct sentences using transition signals; and • write a paragraph using transition signals to achieve coherence.

bcb8aedd1ef3f2083bda.text: your knowledge and understanding by discovering what the topic is all about. Study the given sentences below.

22d4919a739d7279afea.text: In sentence number one, the transition signal ‘and’ is used to connect two incidents equally.

3c855d4e1ebb9b00f8b7.text: While in sentence number two, the transition signal ‘but’ introduces the opposite ideas.

5df52cd64daa5dd50819.text: Take note that simple conjunctions serve different purposes. Conjunctions that join words, phrases, or clauses together are the most basic transition signals.

0734398adb78cb673dd7.text: The words ‘and’ and ‘but’ are examples of transition signals.

6c24d38d2475d6f5d5fe.text: Transition signals are words and phrases that connect ideas of sentences and

406faf356438f9913fa8.text: paragraphs for coherence. They also indicate building up new idea or thought or compare ideas or draw conclusions.

de929ddc84da68c138a7.text: Transition signals are of different types and each type helps to make certain

ef87983d11d9a0379cae.text: Common Types and Functions of Transition Words:

afa3bc3bf8d74a433852.text: 1. Comparison/Contrast points out alternatives or differences:

rows: as also likewise similarly in the same way
but despite however even though on the contrary
fad8cafe058cb6c3e30a.text: Comparison Contrast as also likewise similarly in the same way but despite however even though on the contrary

c64bd4e8a4749edd4112.text: My mom loves pasta, but she dislikes spaghetti. Similarly, she did not

51cbb9888dd892de7632.text: like lasagna. On the contrary, she loves macaroni. Likewise, she loves pancit guisado, pancit bihon, sotanghon, and palabok.

0f2cbb9666284348910d.text: Before you go to the stadium to watch your favorite basketball game, make

729534b60452a7beeefd.text: sure that you have your snacks and video camera that you will use during the game. Later, you will find it enjoyable when you can simultaneously eat while videotaping.

290d8b0f1d5a3b745918.text: 3. Cause/Effect - shows the consequences of an action:

rows: consequently as a result therefore so
ce2929d637ea44fd4c34.text: Cause Effect accordingly because due to since consequently as a result therefore so

431b8d0234e8f4057942.text: Since you have been a consistent honor student and a skillful one,

638b582868dd3e133cb3.text: therefore, there would be a possibility that you would graduate cum laude or be cited with technical skills award in college. As a result, you would have a better chance to find a job or be an entrepreneur, because some companies would prefer those applicants with impressive school records or those with technical skills.

b8bfa2a460e56b3ba322.text: 4. Illustration/Example add emphasis or introduce evidence:

c2ae6fcc0435629c624c.text: Illustration Example to demonstrate specifically truly for example such as namely

6675f5b4d8f32e2a49df.text: Mateo loves vegetables. Truly, he is happy to eat those every day

05783a6d8562312f8ad5.text: demonstrate his love for vegetables, Mateo is planning a vegetable socials for all his friends.

877f7e0657e65e36bb38.text: 5. Addition adds information or reinforces ideas:

1873a2d225dbda2a021f.text: Gabriel loves, respects, and obeys his parents. Moreover, he helps in the

b697eab50f9198da3430.text: household chores if he is not studying. Furthermore, he is grateful that his parents are very supportive in every task he does.

f0337efca331939aef0f.text: I love going to school; that is, I like it very much. In other words, I

5f09dff2e0c326c94ad3.text: want to learn more. To put it another way, a school is one of the best places I need to go for me to learn better.

d59532bb0525e0a98d91.text: lines faced the pandemic with bravery. They almost gave up but recovered. With this in mind, Filipinos have proven time and again to be resilient.

ff2eadd879b47922953f.text: As a learner, it is important to develop a good study habit. You may start before the beginning of the school year. Here are some tips for you. First, you need to plan and organize your activities. For example, plan when you will do your assignments, tests, projects, outputs, and other activities. Also, you need to think about how much time you will spend to each. Second, find a place where you will not be disturbed to study. For instance, studying in front of a television, or with noisy and crowded areas will not be helpful. In addition, texting, online gaming, and facebooking while studying are also forms of disruptions. Third, develop a study plan, knowing the lessons will be easier. Similarly, knowing the different test types will help set your mind. Furthermore, having review-strategies will make studying easier during examinations. Fourth, read a lot. It pays to develop the habit of reading. Lastly, think positive. Having the right mindset will make things different. To sum it up, developing a good study habit will help you succeed.

4270bb9ea2ab9e18f988.text: Once upon a time, there was an orphan whose name was Makato. He didn't

89db58617eb395fd83e9.text: have any ways to support himself, so he did every kind of work such as, carrying heavy things, clearing away forest, and even feeding pigs. Although he was paid only a small wage, he never idled and was satisfied of everything. As a result, people around him noticed his hard work and were very pleased of him.

704078489e5bb79e55df.text: Makato dreamed of going on an adventure to a far and bigger place where the

9f0a877c91e97786f21f.text: land was fertile, and the people were kind. He left his village and set out into the wide world. He walked along cheerfully, enjoying new insights and talking to the people he met on the way. After a long month's journey, he reached a village on the boundary of the Kingdom of Sukhotai. He met an old woman who helped her. He told her that he had come from a far place and he wanted to see the king, who he had heard was kind. He worked with the king's elephants and he started working for her. After some time working, he finally met with the king. During the encounter, he picked up a cowrie shell that was lying on the road and offered it to the king (Cowrie shells were used for money, but just one was practically worthless).

2e2a655597730ed57967.text: When Makato offered the shell to the King, the King said he could keep it.

e486e982bfac66259f83.text: Makato was wondering what he could repay to honor the king's gift. He saw some lettuce seeds at a stall in the market and thought that he could grow them. He asked the woman about them, and she let him have as many as would stick to his finger in return for his treasured cowrie shell. He made the lettuces grew abundantly. The next time he saw the king, he gave one to him and told him he grew them from the shell that he had given him. The king was very impressed and gave him a job in the castle. Eventually, Makato grew up and married the daughter of the king.
